_comment: Functional graphemes for Dutch. Long-vowel doubles (aa/ee/oo/uu) and the monophthongs ie/oe/eu map to single WikiPron phonemes — kept. Diphthongs (ij/ei/au/ou/ui) are encoded as two segments in WikiPron (e.g. 'zei' → ['z','ɛ','i̯']) and are therefore EXCLUDED — including them would make greedy v1 waste the digraph on half the diphthong. Consonant digraphs sch/ch/ng/nk map to single phonemes.
